headline: New: Polymarket supply-chain theft and a 4.9M-person Florida SSN breach; Linux MPTCP flaw and trojanized Claude Code extension still top risks

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports more than $2 million drained from Polymarket traders in a supply-chain attack. Polymarket halted trading and confirmed a cyberattack on a third-party provider.
New: Florida warns that 4.9 million people had Social Security numbers leaked in a breach of its financial aid site.
A critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on servers using MPTCP (Multipath TCP).
The official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor; WIRED reports it reached thousands of developer devices.
North Korea-linked hackers are blamed for the record $6.3 billion Binance theft, which Binance links to a compromised DevOps laptop; nearly $3 billion has been frozen.

Exploited now: GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (KEV due 2026-11-01), Drupal Commerce Core auth bypass CVE-2026-118539, and Cisco SD-WAN CVE-2026-20127 delivering KeyDrift malware.

actions: Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before the 2026-11-01 KEV deadline.
Apply Linux kernel fixes for CVE-2026-46300 (KEV due 2026-10-31) and your distribution's fix for the MPTCP remote-root flaw on servers with MPTCP enabled.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
Patch Drupal Commerce for CVE-2026-118539 and Ivanti Connect Secure for the two flaws CISA added to KEV on 2026-10-30 (due 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13).
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 and hunt for KeyDrift malware; patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709.
Review third-party scripts loaded on pages that handle crypto wallets, given the Polymarket supply-chain attack.
